speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Brother. You look like Father.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have walked since Monday. The likeness is the dust.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: The walking was folly. The barn was vanity. The twenty shillings was right. I have had three weeks to make the three sentences, and they have not improved.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep them. I am too tired to improve a brother.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: The two shillings is the pack and the saddle. I'll have it here, as I said in your mother's kitchen, and not a speech with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two shillings. There. The road is not a kitchen, and the kitchen is paid.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: And the gloves. Mother sent them, and you have carried them like a relic. Give them here before you make them into a tale.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are yours. She put them in. I did not improve the knot.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Now London, since you have been where London is not. The Spaniard was three days in Cornwall and he is gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had Cornwall as talk. I did not have the three days, and I did not have the gone.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Every parish from here to Dover has been turned out to count its pikes. I have counted none. I sell points, not pikes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the gates.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: The marshal's men have been off the gates since the first week of August. You may walk in like a man who is allowed to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Queen.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: She came to Whitehall on Monday. She went into Surrey this morning. You have missed her in both places, which is how a man usually misses her.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Bread.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: No better. Do not ask me for a loaf that meets a notch. The notch is a good year, and this is not that year.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The houses.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: The Rose has bills up for Monday, and so has the Theatre. I saw them on one post in Fleet Street. I did not read your name. I am not going to pretend I know which of your kings you have been mending.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday, then. Not tomorrow. I am not asking you which play. I am not playing tomorrow.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Bartholomew Fair is cried for Sunday. A haberdasher's journeyman will be behind a stall there whether he likes it or no. I do not like it. I will be there. You may buy a point off me and pretend we have not met.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sunday is a fair, and a church before it, if I can stand. I am not promising you a customer.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: And Father owes the baker.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Which baker?

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Sadler. He told thee nothing of it, I'll be bound, and thee eating his mutton.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He told me nothing. I am not paying it tonight. I am not sending it by you, and I am not sending it by Hobbins.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: I was not offered a baker. I was offered two shillings, and I have them. The bed in this house is twopence if you are not walking the last mile tonight. Shared. A man from Coventry has the other half, and he is not my business once you are off the lead.

speaker: (the host)
text: Coventry has the far side. Twopence. The boots stay where I can see them, and the ale is Gilbert's if Gilbert is paying.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twopence. I'll take the bed. I will not take the last mile. The lodging is tomorrow, and tomorrow can have the pack on my own shoulder, for the look of it.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Sleep, then. The ale is on my side, and your back has had enough of every side. You look like Father after a fair, and Father after a fair was no advertisement for the fair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The twenty shillings was right. You may keep that one nearest. The folly and the vanity can walk home with the dust.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: I am unloaded. Four days, and the way was not foul enough to make it eight. If you want a letter carried north, you know the price, and the price is not this conversation.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have no letter tonight. When I have one, it will be a sentence, and you will not have to guess it.
